62 years ago TODAY, President Johnson signed SNAP into law with a promise that hunger should never stand between a family and getting by. 

Six decades later, SNAP is still a lifeline for millions. 

Yet Republicans gutted the program, leaving 344,147 Texas kids without food assistance while billionaires and big corporations got another tax break. 

After 62 years, we know what’s at stake. On the anniversary of SNAP, the fight continues.
